notes: Tier 1 (direct HTTP fetch): pulled robots.txt (no Claude-specific disallow, only generic User-agent: * with standard param/account/cart disallows), and the full sitemap index (sitemap-categories.xml, sitemap-pages.xml, sitemap-products.xml, sitemap-articles.xml, sitemap-buying-guides.xml). Grepped sitemap-categories.xml (362 lines, ~280 distinct category URLs covering every fan model, downlight type, globe base-type, switch range etc. -- an exhaustive, fine-grained taxonomy) for christmas|xmas|halloween|easter|diwali|valentine|thanksgiving|new-year|festive|holiday|seasonal. Only hits: /christmas-gift-guide and its 4 price-tier children (gifts-under-50/100/200/300). No Halloween/Diwali/Easter/Valentine/Thanksgiving/New Year URLs anywhere in the category, page, or article sitemaps. Homepage static HTML has no Christmas/seasonal nav link either. Since the gift-guide pages are client-rendered (Next.js streaming, product grid loads via Suspense/skeleton in raw HTML), escalated to Tier 3 (Claude-in-Chrome; robots.txt has no Claude bot block) to render and verify. Findings: (1) /christmas-gift-guide (134 products) is a cross-category price-driven marketing gift guide -- table lamps, pedestal/wall fans, candles, room sprays, portable chargers, LED wreaths etc., all shown at 'Last Chance to Buy' sale pricing -- not a Christmas-specific product taxonomy; excluded per the gift-guide/marketing-page rule (fails criterion 1 and 2: not a genuine holiday-associated PLP, just 'gifts for the Christmas period' pulled from unrelated departments). (2) /exterior/party-festoon-lights (10 products) is a general 'Party & Festoon Lights' occasion category (description: 'outdoor gatherings... all your celebrations'), not branded or scoped to any specific holiday -- excluded as a normal category that merely contains some seasonal-adjacent items (one LED wreath) rather than being itself a holiday category. (3) Rendered the Exterior mega-menu (669 products, subcats: Security & Sensor, Floodlights, Wall Lights, Landscape, Exterior Fans, Step Lights, Festoon Lights, Exterior Pendants, Solar & DIY, Deck Lighting) -- no Christmas Lighting / outdoor holiday-lighting subcategory despite this being a lighting-focused retailer where such a category would be expected if it existed. (4) Rendered /interior/homewares (50 products: candles, room sprays, ornamental animals, cleaning kits) -- no seasonal subcategory. (5) Site search for 'christmas' returned 0 products (used only as a supplementary signal, not as sole proof of absence, per the false-absence rule -- absence was independently confirmed via the category sitemap and rendered mega-menus above). Conclusion: Beacon Lighting (AU) has no genuine site-taxonomy seasonal/holiday product category for any festival (Christmas, Halloween, Diwali, Easter, Valentine's Day, Thanksgiving, New Year). rows left empty.
